editorial:
Imagine being so good at your job that your special skill becomes a dangerous weapon. You follow a piano tuner who has an amazing ear for sound, but he soon finds out that hearing the tiny clicks of a safe lock is just like tuning a piano. It starts as a curious experiment, but before you know it, he is deep in the world of high-stakes crime. The vibe is tense and gritty, making you feel the pressure as he tries to balance his quiet life with the thrill of stealing from the rich. It is a cool ride that shows how a simple talent can totally change your path in life.

The acting is top-notch, and the way the movie handles sound makes the safe-cracking scenes feel real and exciting. While the middle part drags a little bit, the big twists at the end make up for it. You should definitely check this out if you love heist movies with a smart lead.
endingExplained: In the final act, you discover that the tuner was actually being played by his crime boss all along. During the last big heist, the boss tries to lock him inside the vault to take all the money. However, the tuner uses his hearing to find a hidden flaw in the vault wall and escapes just in time. He ends up stealing the boss's own secret stash and disappears, starting a new life with the money.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves smart heist movies and unexpected character turns.
